summary.en: Middle English abandounen (English verb attested in the 14th century) was borrowed from Anglo-French abanduner, derived from abandun and a bandun, referring to power or disposal. Continental Old French à bandon likewise concerns disposal; abandonner is derived from abandon (CNRTL records releasing a rein around 1100 and leaving entirely from the 12th century). This supports the development toward relinquish/give up. It is not historically ban + donner. Bandon belongs to a Germanic command/jurisdiction background; this is not the author’s modern segmentation. Bandon itself means power/authority, not release. The displayed pathway is a semantic abstraction, not a strict chronology of first attestations.
summary.zh-Hans: 中古英语 abandounen（英语动词见于14世纪）借自盎格鲁法语 abanduner，后者由 abandun 及 a bandun 发展，涉及支配与处置。欧洲大陆古法语 à bandon 同样涉及任其处置；abandonner 派生自 abandon（CNRTL 记约1100年的松开缰绳义及12世纪起的完全离开义）。这支持向 relinquish/give up 的语义发展。历史上不是 ban + donner。bandon 具有日耳曼语命令／管辖词族背景，但不是作者提出的现代拆分。 bandon 本身为权力／支配，不是释放。展示路径是语义抽象，不是首见年代的严格序列。

claim.en: English ban (verb) continues Old English bannan, a Germanic proclamation/command verb; Middle English prohibitive senses reflect Norse influence, with later French/Latin influence. The English noun partly derives from the verb and partly from Anglo-French. French ban /bɑ̃/ is a masculine noun of Old Low Franconian origin: public proclamation, feudal summons/jurisdiction, banns, and exclusion in expressions such as mettre au ban. It is not the ordinary French verb “to prohibit” (interdire); the old note’s French ban v. 禁止 is corrected. This distinction does not cancel the independently proposed English ban ↔ 甭 candidate.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语动词 ban 承自古英语 bannan，属于日耳曼语宣告／命令词族；中古英语禁止等义受古诺斯语影响，后又受法语／拉丁语影响。英语名词部分来自动词，部分借自盎格鲁法语。法语 ban /bɑ̃/ 为阳性名词，源于古低地法兰克语，涉及公告、封建征召／管辖、婚姻公告及 mettre au ban 等排斥用语；它不是通常表示“禁止”的法语动词（interdire）。旧笔记“法语 ban v. 禁止”已纠正，这不取消独立的英语 ban ↔ 甭 候选。

claim.en: English banal is borrowed from French (Merriam-Webster: first known English use 1825). CNRTL traces French banal to feudal ban plus -al, with bannel attested in 1247 and the very common/unoriginal sense in 1798. Merriam-Webster describes a Medieval Latin bannalis route for Old French bannel. Both accounts connect seigneurial jurisdiction and shared-use facilities with the later commonplace sense. Neither derives it from Chinese. Ban and banal are separately evaluated observations, but their related European histories must be deduplicated in any family-based experiment.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 banal 借自法语（Merriam-Webster 记英语首见1825年）。CNRTL 将法语 banal 分析为封建法 ban 加 -al，记1247年 bannel 及1798年的极普通／无新意义；Merriam-Webster 则通过中古拉丁语 bannalis 解释古法语 bannel。两者均联系领主管辖、共同使用设施与后来的平常义，不从汉语倒推词史。ban 和 banal 的观察独立评价，但欧洲词史相关，实验按词源家族去重。

claim.en: 办 — HANDLE / MANAGE. Semantic fit Low; phonetic group fit High: b. Modern 办 means handle/manage. abandon，放弃。甭beng。ban与甭同音
英語
abandon [ə'bændən] v. 放弃 [<法语]
a.ban.don
abandonment [ə'bændənmənt] n. 抛弃 [<法语]
ban [bæn] v. 禁止 [<法语]
banal [banal] a. 一般的，平凡.般。可以对应般ban
band n. 一帮，一伙
法語
abandonner [abandonner] v. 抛弃
a.ban.don.ner
ban v. 禁止。可以用甭beng这个字代表。
donner v. 送。用捅tong字对应，给谁的意思，捅钱。
漢語
甭【beng】v. 用法语ban禁止对应，英语ban禁止对应。
旁【pang】n. 旁边的旁字变成使动的用法，放到一旁，抛弃。与法语ban禁止对应，英语ban禁止对应。这里给一个可能性而已。
捅【tong】v. 给的意思。与法语donner给字对应，与英语donate给予对应。
动【dong】v.
备注：为什么这里分开ban而不是band，因为这个词从法语来，法语里面没有band这个词，是bande包扎。法语中有ban禁止，interdict禁止。法语donner，给的意思。合起来就是禁止给=放弃。如果仅仅从英语角度也可以有这样的解释：a- [a] pref. 没有的意思，用罢ba字对应。band [band] n. 帮伙。不过仅仅是记忆方便这样说，因为这个词从法语而来最后还是从法语角度介绍为好。现在考虑abadon这个词

evidence_note.zh-Hans: 汉典停止义引《史记·魏公子列传》；保留作放弃活动的替代终点。

nodes.semantic_loss: Medium: stopping may be temporary or completion; Low fit for deserting a person. This is an alternative endpoint, not a sixth historical stage.
nodes.semantic_loss_zh: 中：停止可能短暂或只是完成；针对遗弃某人适配低。此为替代终点，不是第六历史阶段。

boundary.en: A structural comparison, not a Chinese etymological chain or cross-language cognacy. Historical Relation: Not claimed. Arrows order semantic relations, not five successive first-attestation dates. Modern Mandarin onsets are the declared constraint; b /p/, p /pʰ/, m /m/, f /f/ are a proposed class, not identical sounds. No reconstruction of Old Chinese or Old French pronunciation is claimed.
boundary.zh-Hans: 这是结构比较，不是汉字间的派生链或英汉同源。Historical Relation: Not claimed。箭头排列语义关系，不代表五个依次出现的首见年代。约束明确采用现代普通话声母：b /p/、p /pʰ/、m /m/、f /f/ 是候选组，不是同音；未重构上古汉语或古法语发音。

research_question.en: Can a historical semantic path be reconstructed across languages while preserving a proposed consonant class?
research_question.zh-Hans: 在保持候选辅音组的条件下，能否跨语言重构一条历史语义路径？

workflow.en: Freeze the source-language historical semantic path with dated evidence and stage boundaries.
workflow.zh-Hans: 先冻结来源语言历史语义路径、时间见证与阶段边界。

workflow.en: Construct the Chinese semantic-best path without using sound as a selection criterion.
workflow.zh-Hans: 不以声音为选择标准，构造汉语语义优先路径。

workflow.en: Apply the b-p-m-f constraint with declared modern Mandarin onset and compound rules.
workflow.zh-Hans: 再施加 b-p-m-f 约束，声明普通话声母及复词规则。

workflow.en: Record each node’s semantic loss and lower support where it is substantial.
workflow.zh-Hans: 逐节点记录语义损失；损失明显则降低假说支持。

workflow.en: In future, compare d-t-n-l and g-k-h controls under identical vocabulary, compound, scoring and search-budget rules; retain failures and deduplicate families.
workflow.zh-Hans: 未来在相同词汇范围、复词、评分及检索预算规则下比较 d-t-n-l、g-k-h 控制组；保留失败例，按词源家族去重。

audit.en: Retrospective editorial case, not a blinded or preregistered experiment: the proposed b-words were already visible. Baseline selection uses semantic criteria, but evaluator blindness is not claimed. These nodes belong to one historical case, not five or six independent observations. No controlled support estimate exists.
audit.zh-Hans: 这是回顾性编辑案例，不是盲评或预注册实验：候选 b 字此前已可见。基线按语义标准选择，但不声称评估者盲态。各节点属于同一历史案例，不是五六个独立观察；尚无对照支持度估计。

scores.scale: Experimental editorial High/Medium/Low; not measured scientific scores
scores.decision: Significant loss at 办; narrower 拨付 and 罢. Do not promote the consonant-group or skeleton hypothesis.
